label: Confidence levels
description: How sure we are that a research entry's factual claims are correct. Our own design proposals (aim, crew, how it plays) are marked as proposals and not rated.

terms.label: High
terms.description: The sources include official text about the unit, read directly or through a faithful copy that says what it copies, or pages from two different established sites that each describe the unit and agree. A page counts only if it is about the unit itself: its own page, or its own entry in a unit list. Patch notes and pages about other units do not count toward high. Pages of one site count as one site. Two wikis count as independent unless one names the other as its source.

terms.label: Medium
terms.description: Everything rests on one established site (any number of its pages) or one database, and nothing contradicts it.

terms.label: Low
terms.description: From a forum, a guide, a search snippet or a single unclear source. Needs a check before use.
